name: CDN / WAF Detection (cdncheck)
summary: Detects CDN and WAF providers for IP addresses and domains using ProjectDiscovery's cdncheck dataset (MIT license).
description:
Run it before treating an address as the site's own: an IP in a CDN or WAF edge range belongs to the provider, not to the site's origin server.

**Who sees it:** the IP check contacts no one; it matches against ranges shipped with the pack. The hostname check sends each domain and CNAME hop to Cloudflare's DNS-over-HTTPS resolver, or to Google Public DNS when Cloudflare fails. The target's web servers are not contacted, and its name servers are queried by the resolver rather than by the analyst's machine.

**Read results with care:**

- **No match is not "no CDN".** Providers known only by hostname, such as Akamai, are not matched by IP; a domain that resolves straight to A or AAAA records, with no CNAME, is not matched by hostname; and cloud hosting ranges (AWS, GCP, Azure) are left out on purpose, as a different signal.
- **A hostname match names no provider.** The DNS Record node holds the first hostname in the CNAME chain that matched; the provider's name is not recorded.
- **Snapshot.** The ranges and patterns are a copy of cdncheck taken when the pack was built and change only with a new pack version.

**Data and licences:** ProjectDiscovery cdncheck, https://github.com/projectdiscovery/cdncheck, MIT, Copyright (c) 2021 ProjectDiscovery, Inc.; its cdn, waf and common categories (2,466 CDN and 1,024 WAF ranges, 103 hostname patterns for 32 providers).

**Source:** https://github.com/Vineyard-Intelligence/pluginpack-cdn-detect (Apache-2.0)

plugins.name: Detect CDN/WAF (IP)
plugins.description: Matches each selected IP Address against known CDN and WAF IP ranges (cdncheck) and sets the IP's organization to the matched provider, e.g. "cloudflare (WAF)". Unmatched IPs are left unchanged; creates no nodes.

plugins.name: Detect CDN (Hostname)
plugins.description: Follows each selected Domain's CNAME chain and matches it against known CDN hostname patterns (cdncheck). On a match, creates a CNAME DNS Record node (the matching hostname) linked "has record".

network.purpose: Resolve the CNAME chain of each selected domain.
Same lookup, used when cloudflare-dns.com fails.
